Common tasks run from the repo root (`package.json`):

| Script | Command |
|---|---|
| `yarn build` | `turbo run build` |
| `yarn build:services` | `turbo run build --filter=rocketchat-services...` |
| `yarn dev` | `turbo run dev --env-mode=loose --parallel --filter=@rocket.chat/meteor...` |
| `yarn dsv` | `turbo run dsv --env-mode=loose --filter=@rocket.chat/meteor...` |
| `yarn ms` | `turbo run ms --env-mode=loose` |
| `yarn fossify` | `TS_NODE_COMPILER_OPTIONS='{"module": "commonjs"}' ts-node scripts/fossify.ts` |
| `yarn fuselage` | `./fuselage.sh` |
| `yarn lint` | `turbo run lint` |
| `yarn storybook` | `yarn workspace @rocket.chat/meteor run storybook` |
| `yarn test-storybook` | `turbo run test-storybook` |
| `yarn testunit` | `turbo run testunit` |

Sources: package.json:1

Builds are orchestrated by **turbo** (`turbo.json`); tasks and their upstream dependencies:

| Task | Depends on |
|---|---|
| `build-preview` | `^build` |
| `.:build-preview-move` | `^build-preview` |
| `build` | `^build` |
| `test-storybook` | — |
| `testunit` | — |
| `lint` | — |
| `typecheck` | — |
| `dev` | `^dev` |
| `dsv` | `build` |
| `ms` | `^build` |

Sources: turbo.json:1

GitHub Actions runs 16 workflows on push/PR:

| Workflow | Triggers | File |
|---|---|---|
| Auto-close duplicate issues | `schedule`, `workflow_dispatch` | `.github/workflows/auto-close-duplicates.yml` |
| Code Checks | `workflow_call` | `.github/workflows/ci-code-check.yml` |
| Deploy GitHub Pages | `push` | `.github/workflows/ci-deploy-gh-pages.yml` |
| Tests E2E | `release`, `workflow_call` | `.github/workflows/ci-test-e2e.yml` |
| Test Storybook | `workflow_call` | `.github/workflows/ci-test-storybook.yml` |
| Tests Unit | `workflow_call` | `.github/workflows/ci-test-unit.yml` |
| CI | `push`, `pull_request`, `release` | `.github/workflows/ci.yml` |
| Code scanning - action | `push`, `pull_request`, `schedule` | `.github/workflows/codeql-analysis.yml` |
| Rocket.Chat Issue Dedupe | `workflow_dispatch` | `.github/workflows/dedupe-issues.yml` |
| Start new release | `workflow_dispatch` | `.github/workflows/new-release.yml` |
| Release PR Description | `pull_request` | `.github/workflows/pr-update-description.yml` |
| Publish Final Release | `push` | `.github/workflows/publish-release.yml` |
| Release candidate cut | `schedule` | `.github/workflows/release-candidate.yml` |
| Close inactive issues | `schedule` | `.github/workflows/stale.yml` |
| Create issues from TODOs | `push`, `workflow_dispatch` | `.github/workflows/todo.yml` |
| Update Version Durability | `workflow_dispatch`, `workflow_call` | `.github/workflows/update-version-durability.yml` |
